dogecoin.text: According to the Wall Street Journal, Dogecoin was created as a satirical homage to bitcoin, and serves no actual purpose (other than generating a few laughs).

Everyone, including a few rappers and tech billionaires, can’t seem to peel their attention away from Dogecoin.

Dogecoin - as in the coin that literally started as a joke in 2013 based off of the doge meme.
